newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FANS ALERTED TO SUPER BOWL TICKET SCAMS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FANS ALERTED TO SUPER BOWL TICKET SCAMS.

text.p: Fans flying to the January 26 Super Bowl in New Orleans should make sure that any tour package they buy includes a guarantee of a ticket to the football game, the Transportation Department said Wednesday.

It said that its Truth in Ticketing rules require that an operator marketing a Super Bowl air package that includes a game ticket must have the ticket in hand or a written contract for the ticket before he can run any advertising.

It cautioned fans to make sure they have the ticket or a written confirmation, adding that if a game ticket is not specifically mentioned in the advertising, it probably is not included in the air package.
The department said the Super Bowl rule was extended in 1994 to all air tours advertised for the purpose of attending any sporting, social or other special, limited-duration event.
